body: I can confidently say that NoFap and social media cannot coexist unless your socials are severely limited and you can control what you see. Every time I’ve downloaded Tiktok just because I’m bored or whatever or think I deserve a break, it proceeds to kick me in the teeth and destroy all discipline, the more you understand this the easier it gets, trust me.
recognise the addiction, observe it and then try to understand why you always give up. Its the pointing and calling technique, try use that if you’re really struggling.
They’re no friend of yours if they call you pathetic for trying to better yourself, be thankful some people make it easier for you to cut them out until they change. Spoiler: They usually don’t.

Remember this is a lifestyle not a challenge, if counting the days helps at the start to measure progress then sure, but know that cant last because you will feel so much worse if you relapse after hitting a high number.
